name: Indiana Dunes National Park
policyReason: Pets are permitted everywhere including beaches, with a few exceptions.
summary: Pets are permitted everywhere including beaches, with a few exceptions.

excerpts.quote: Pets are permitted everywhere including beaches in the national park with the following exceptions:

dogRules.text: Not on the Pinhook Bog Trail (Upland Trail is fine).
Not on the equestrian portion of the Glenwood Dunes Trail system.
Not in the West Beach lifeguarded area in summer.
